summary: Live Playwright diagnosis of word-by-word/probe-card animations on sage-workspace.html: no JS errors, all animations resolve, zero words stuck at opacity 0; two UX findings (silent no-send without ?session=, sessions list not loaded on bare page boot)

detail: [ERROR] Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404 (Not Found) @ http://raspberrypi.local:8000/favicon.ico:0
1_console_errors.verdict: Only a missing favicon 404. Zero JavaScript errors or uncaught exceptions during load, send, streaming, and probe-card rendering.

findings.2_screenshot_as_loaded: .agents/jobs/evidence/T-anim-debug-as-loaded.jpeg — bare URL shows empty state: 'No session selected / Select a session from the sidebar or create a new one', topbar status '- Loading...', phase badge 'setup'. NOTE: first as-loaded capture was saved by the Playwright MCP into its own output dir which is not reachable from this shell; recaptured via run_code with an absolute UNC path into .agents/jobs/evidence/.

3_send_teach_me_recursion.why: On the bare URL the Send click was a silent no-op: sendMessage() line 1308 `if (!text || streaming || !sessionId) return;` bails because sessionId comes only from the ?session= query param (line 394). No network request fired. Re-tested after navigating to ?session=c767ee4dd972452c80b355a1f9d76410.
3_send_teach_me_recursion.note: Page scrollHeight (1249px) equals innerHeight (1249px) at 2560px width, so fullPage and viewport captures are legitimately byte-identical (hash 1CC03548...C5C50B3).

4_msg_computed_animation.history_msg: msgCascade 0.7s cubic-bezier(0.33, 1, 0.68, 1) 0s both running — opacity 1, transform identity matrix, display flex
4_msg_computed_animation.verdict: Animation property IS present and resolved on every .msg; msgCascade keyframe is registered.

5_word_span_computed_style.verdict: No stuck/invisible words. The fix-anim hardening (capped delays, fallback visibility) is holding under live traffic.

unreadable_detail.error: SecurityError: Failed to read the 'cssRules' property from 'CSSStyleSheet': Cannot access rules
unreadable_detail.interpretation: NOT a load failure — the cross-origin stylesheet loaded fine (it is in document.styleSheets); CSSOM rule access is blocked by spec for cross-origin sheets without CORS headers.

8_prefers_reduced_motion.verdict: Animations are NOT being suppressed by OS/browser reduced-motion setting in this context.

side_findings_not_source_changes: UX: composer stays enabled with no session selected; Send silently does nothing (guard at static/sage-workspace.html line 1308). A disabled composer, tooltip, or auto-session-creation would prevent the dead click.

Boot gap: on a bare (session-less) load, /api/sessions is never fetched so the sidebar Sessions list renders empty; loadSessionsList() only runs inside the session-detail loader (line 1461) or after a first turn (line 1435). Verified by absence of the request in the network log on bare load, presence of GET /api/sessions => 200 when called manually (1 session returned).
Console favicon.ico 404 on every load — cosmetic but it is the only console error the page ever emits.
final_report: PASS on animation health: live Playwright run against http://raspberrypi.local:8000/sage-workspace.html shows zero JavaScript errors (only a favicon 404), msgCascade applied to all .msg elements, wordIn applied to all .word spans with 236/236 at opacity 1 (zero stuck), artifactReveal applied to 3 visible probe cards, 5/6 stylesheets readable with 364 rules (the 6th is the Google Fonts cross-origin sheet whose cssRules are CORS-blocked by spec, not failed), prefers-reduced-motion reduce=false so nothing suppresses motion. Probe cards appeared after sending 'teach me recursion' from a session-scoped URL. Two non-animation findings recorded: (1) Send silently no-ops without a ?session= query param — sendMessage guards on !sessionId and the composer stays enabled; (2) the sidebar sessions list never loads on a bare page boot because loadSessionsList() is only invoked inside the session-detail path or after a first turn. Screenshots in .agents/jobs/evidence/. No source files modified.
